# UNCANNY

Current public release: v0.20.0-alpha.1 — ELYSIUM Engine 4.5 — HF18.11
BuildId: elysium45-hf18.11
updateSerial: 1910
ABI: 143
Package: UNCANNY-v0.20.0-alpha.1-ELYSIUM-ENGINE45-HF18.11.zip
SHA-256: 7e4d0f990ab33f10abec01a23ff467e487ad45da2b250cd49b6823b321c3d800
Release: https://github.com/coye2/UNCANNY/releases/latest

UNCANNY is a Windows real-time graphics remastering runtime for games and emulators.

HF18.11 restores staged neural promotion on direct D3D11 while keeping the fail-open stability path. HF18.10 D3D12 startup/resize protection and the PCSX2 D3D12 Renderer=15 route remain in place.

The native ELYSIUM path and optional neural/DLSS 5 route are separate. REVENANT asset replacement is experimental.
